html:
Showcase website for Betus Design, live at btsdesign.com.tr. A client project, completed and delivered.

Built with React and TypeScript on Vite, routed with TanStack Router and styled with Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui components.

Development

bun install
bun run dev      # Vite dev server
bun run build    # production build
bun run lint
bun run typecheck # tsc --noEmit
bun run format   # Prettier

Deployment

Pushes to main are built and published to GitHub Pages by .github/workflows/deploy.yml, under the custom domain in CNAME. The workflow runs lint and typecheck before building, and the build copies index.html to 404.html so deep links fall back to the client-side router.
